data.title: Leash order for your dog "Bruno"
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt public order office (Ordnungsamt) ordered on 15 May 2025 that your dog must be kept on a leash of at most two metres outside your enclosed property, following an incident on 28 April 2025. A coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €250 is threatened for non-compliance.
data.explanation: The city has ordered that, with immediate effect, your dog must be on a leash no longer than two metres whenever outside your fenced or enclosed property. If you break this rule, a coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €250 is threatened. You may disagree by filing a court action (Klage) at the administrative court, in writing or recorded at the court registry. There is no objection procedure (Widerspruch) first. The app shows the deadline for this. Consider getting legal advice if you want to challenge the order.

items.title: File court action against the leash order
items.action: If you disagree with the order, file a court action (Klage) at the administrative court in writing or recorded by the court registry.
items.consequence: After the deadline the order becomes final and can no longer be challenged.
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Klage beim Verwaltungsgericht Musterstadt, Justizzentrum, Gerichtsstraße 5, 44135 Musterstadt, erhoben werden.
